note: The Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina's ten cantons by post-1995 municipality (BHAS codes as in data/source/bih_census_1991.json). Cantons are named in the Federation Constitution, Article I(2) (1994), and their municipalities were set by the Law on Federal Units (Zakon o federalnim jedinicama, Sluzbene novine FBiH 9/96, June 1996), after Dayton. Display data for the Dayton place card (DC plan stage 3); nothing in the simulation reads it. tools/peace/derive_osid_cantons.cjs joins it to the cells.
